title: Analysis and Prediction of PM2.5 Pollution in Madrid
Analysis and Prediction of PM2.5 Pollution in Madrid
text:
🎯 Research motivation
Urban PM2.5 pollution remains an important environmental and public-health concern.
The project addresses three complementary questions:

How have PM2.5 concentrations evolved in Madrid over time?
How do pollution patterns differ across districts?
Can a hybrid Prophet-LSTM model provide useful forecasts for future PM2.5 levels?

The methodological emphasis is not limited to prediction. The analysis integrates data understanding, preprocessing, descriptive analysis, spatial interpretation and forecasting within a reproducible workflow.

title: Analysis and Prediction of PM2.5 Pollution in Madrid
text:
📌 Main findings

PM2.5 concentrations show a general downward trend from 2019 to mid-2024.
Important year-to-year variability and pollution peaks remain.
PM2.5 patterns differ across monitored districts.
The hybrid forecasting framework combines explicit temporal structure with nonlinear sequence modelling.
The resulting analysis can support environmental planning and urban decision-making.

title: Analysis and Prediction of PM2.5 Pollution in Madrid
text:
🧭 Methodological interpretation
The main contribution of this work is the integration of open urban data, CRISP-DM and hybrid time-series modelling into a coherent environmental analytics workflow.
The repository therefore emphasises reproducibility, transparent preprocessing, temporal and spatial interpretation, open data and forecasting as a decision-support tool.

title: Scripts and Analytical Workflow
text:
🧩 Workflow by stage

Data preparation
01_data_preprocessing.py creates the analysis-ready PM2.5 data structures used by the downstream scripts.


Descriptive and temporal analysis
03_descriptive_analysis.py and 04_trends_by_district.py generate the statistical and temporal summaries used to characterise PM2.5 evolution.


Spatial analysis
02_spatial_analysis.py, 05_districts_pm25_map.py and 06_stations_map.py support spatial interpretation and monitoring-network visualisation.


Forecasting
07_hybrid_forecasting.py implements the citywide Prophet-LSTM workflow.
08_district_forecasting.py applies the forecasting framework at district level.
